page.subtitle: Scan the cloned repo to surface house-rules — each backed by evidence you can turn into a Skill.

empty.title: No conventions extracted yet
empty.body: Scan the repo to surface house-rules — naming, error handling, structure — each backed by evidence you can turn into a Skill.

page.candidateCount: {count, plural, one {# candidate} other {# candidates}} · grounded against sampled files

header.detected: Detected from {count, plural, one {# sample file} other {# sample files}} · last scan {when}

neverScanned.title: No analysis yet
neverScanned.body: Scan the repo to surface house-rules — naming, error handling, structure — each backed by evidence you can turn into a Skill.

notIndexed.title: This repo is not indexed yet
notIndexed.body: The scan reads a sample of files picked from the repo index. Index the repository first, then the scan can start.
notIndexed.notCloned: This repository is not cloned yet. Clone it, then it is indexed and can be scanned.

scanning.title: Scanning the repo…
scanning.body: Usually under a minute, up to ~2 minutes. The page updates when the scan finishes.

failed.title: The last scan failed
failed.fallback: The scan stopped before it produced results.
failed.olderNote: Candidates from an earlier scan are still listed below.

zeroVerified.title: No conventions passed verification
zeroVerified.body: {count, plural, =0 {The model proposed nothing it could back with code.} one {# candidate was dropped because its evidence was not found in the repo.} other {# candidates were dropped because their evidence was not found in the repo.}}

allRejected.title: Every candidate is rejected
allRejected.body: Nothing is left to review. Open the Rejected tab to bring one back, or re-scan.

tabEmpty.accepted: Nothing accepted yet. Accept a candidate on the All tab and it lands here.

toolbar.createSkillHint: Select accepted conventions on the Accepted tab first.

badges.flagged: {count, plural, one {flagged in # review} other {flagged in # reviews}}
badges.cited: {count, plural, one {# cited example} other {# cited examples}}

rejectConfirm.title: Reject this convention?
rejectConfirm.body: It is already part of a skill. Skills are snapshots, so the skill keeps this rule after you reject it. Edit the skill by hand to remove it.

modal.title: Create skill from conventions
modal.banner: Merged from {count, plural, one {# accepted convention} other {# accepted conventions}} in {repo}. Everything below is editable before you save.
modal.name: Name
modal.nameHint: Lowercase letters, digits and hyphens; 2 to 64 characters.
modal.nameInvalid: Use lowercase letters, digits and hyphens, 2 to 64 characters, starting with a letter or digit.
modal.nameTaken: A skill named "{name}" already exists. Pick another name.
modal.descriptionDefault: {count, plural, one {# house convention} other {# house conventions}} extracted from {repo}
modal.enabledHint: Whether this block is added to agents' prompts.
modal.rawCommentWarning: This body contains HTML comments, hidden from the rendered view.
modal.rawInvisibleWarning: This body contains invisible or bidirectional characters, marked below.
modal.attachHint: Up to {max} agents. The skill is linked to each in the same step.

budget.title: Skills budget (24 KB per agent)
budget.unknownRemaining: Remaining budget of the selected agents is not available.

errors.budget: Attaching would push {name} over its 24 KB skills budget. Shorten the body, disable the skill or detach that agent.
errors.budgetUnknown: One of the selected agents would exceed its 24 KB skills budget. Shorten the body or detach agents.
errors.notAccepted: One of the selected conventions is no longer accepted. Close this dialog and review the selection.

modal.footerNote: Saved as v1 · added to Skills Lab

dirty.title: Discard this skill?
dirty.body: You have edited this skill. Closing now throws the edits away.

success.title: Skill created
success.body: "{name}" was saved as v1 and added to Skills Lab.
success.linked: {count, plural, one {Linked to # agent.} other {Linked to # agents.}}

errors.scan_deadline_exceeded: The scan took too long and was stopped. Try again.
errors.empty_sample: No readable code files were found to sample. Check that the repo has source files and is indexed.
errors.head_moved: The repository changed while the scan was running. Run it again.
errors.repo_not_indexed: The repository is not indexed yet. Index it, then scan.
errors.repo_not_cloned: The repository is not cloned yet. Clone it, then scan.
errors.interrupted: The scan was interrupted because the server restarted. Run it again.
